d: OliOli® Doha is inviting candidates to join an amazing group of people and help their mission to deliver exciting, joyful, differentiated, world-class, and incredibly fun experiences to children that nurture their innate sense of curiosity and exploration.

OliOli® (means joy in the Hawaiian language) is a multiple award-winning contemporary children's museum. Founded by a group of parents who are passionate about open-ended, non-judgmental play, OliOli® entails 6 interactive galleries comprising over 45 hands-on exhibits.

The awesome team at OliOli® comes from 19 countries, including France, India, Tunisia, Mexico, South Africa, Germany, Taiwan, Algeria, Kazakhstan, Kenya, Sri Lanka, Philippines, Ghana, Morocco, Pakistan, Bangladesh, North Macedonia, Sudan, and Lebanon. Find out more information about OliOli® Doha @ http://www.olioli.qa/ or http://www.instagram.com/oliolidoha.

We are young parents who have been blessed to follow our dream. Our dream is for children to be happier, more creative, more imaginative, more informed, inspired, aware, balanced, and amazed. We aim to see joy on children's faces.
WHAT THIS ROLE IS ALL ABOUT

As the Accounts Executive, you will be responsible for managing day-to-day accounting operations, financial record-keeping, reconciliations, accounts receivable and payable processes, procurement support, and financial administration. You will ensure accurate financial transactions, support month-end closing activities, and coordinate with internal departments and external stakeholders to support efficient business operations.
Maintain and execute the Books of Account.
Perform daily and monthly reconciliation of sales from various channels, including POS, e-commerce, third-party apps, and online payment gateway/Pay-by Link.
Execute refund transactions to customers through bank and online payment gateway.
Prepare local and international invoicing and payments to suppliers in line with policies.
Enter all financial transactions into Accounting Software.
Obtain quotations, prepare comparative analysis, supplier onboarding, issue POs, process invoices, and payments.
Coordinate and liaise with internal and external stakeholders.
Manage monthly closing: prepare bank reconciliation, cash flow statement, schedules, accrual entries, and perform GL reconciliation.
Manage Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable processes.
Oversee timely renewal of company contracts, certificates, insurances, and licenses.
Review contracts, agreements, Insurance policies, etc.
Prepare monthly contract declarations and withholding tax payments.
Assist audits and support the Finance Manager in preparing financial documents and reports
Maintain a list of all contacts of third-party vendors.
Organize all documentation physically and electronically in an efficient manner.
Support Facilities and other departments in administrative tasks.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, or related field preferred.
Minimum 2–3 years of relevant work experience in a procurement, accounting, and admin role in Qatar is required.
Familiarity with procurement systems and software.
Sound knowledge of Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable processes.
Understanding of basic financial and accounting principles (GAAP/IFRS).
Proficiency with financial software and Microsoft 365, especially in Excel.
Understanding of basic financial and accounting principles (GAAP/IFRS).
Familiar with budgeting and financial statements (balance sheet, income statement, cash flow).
Self-starter, self-motivated, with lots of positive energy, patience, empathy, and courtesy.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Strong attention to detail, accuracy, meticulousness, and organizational skills.
Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time efficiently.
Flexibility to meet the demands of our growing organization.
Ability to work independently, take ownership of tasks, and demonstrate strong problem-solving skills.
